cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

mechanism: Copy a guest's teacup pose without knowing it is cooling a burn, then use that cover to ask around an earlier visitor's identity through drink habits.
confusable: Not asking who visited in a decorative metaphor: A must never directly request the hidden identity and must use each surrounding clue.
comparison: A shared teacup exchange and sugar habits differ from a dinner route and departure timing inquiry.
seedUse: Retains extra cup/visitor/sugar investigation while removing explicit who questions and adding a misunderstood cup posture.
